d: Delhi to ban old, polluting vehicles from entering city limits from November 1. Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta has announced a winter action plan to tackle the annual air pollution which plagues the Indian capital. One major part of the plan is to stop vehicles that are not BS-VI compliant from entering Delhi. Firstpost looks at the new rules, and explains which vehicles are allowed and which are banned from Delhi between November and January. Hem Kaur Saroya also tells you how you can check to see if your car is BS-6 compliant. HKS also lists the exceptions to the Delhi vehicle ban.
